title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked September 23, 2026 at 15:32 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 425 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Calm conditions right now. ✨🌎

A few bright active regions and broad dark coronal structures are visible today, while the coronagraph remains unremarkable.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
